hunting_summary: Attacked the claim from five angles. (1) Reproduction: could NOT re-execute probes (no execution tool — recorded per channel above); instead verified the kill through the machine-side heavy-lock history, which is written by research/governance, not by the audited script: exactly two STOCKS-NG3 runs exist machine-wide, both P0_CENSUS, both FAILED, killed-reasons byte-identical to the manifests (404x3 attempt-1, 403x3 attempt-2) — no lane, E-phase, or any other execution ever ran, so 0 cells / budget 0/6 is corroborated, not just asserted. (2) Prematurity: the implementers did hunt alternatives before closing — after the legacy /api/earnings/ 404'd (attempt-1), they re-pointed E1 at /api/fundamentals (attempt-2) and probed calendar-earnings; both blocked; both attempts independently yield BLOCKED so there is no channel-shopping that could have rescued a PASS; the two unprobed residual channels are recorded as T3 and do not carry realized EPS history under the same gate. (3) Preregistration: E1 kill text is present in both root and worktree plan copies, attested pre-measurement by the frozen plan-audit artifact (00:00:00Z vs census 02:27/02:33Z), registry records the amendment as pre-P0, and the reflog shows no branch movement after the terminal commit; floors E1/E2/E3/E4 and fold boundaries in the manifest match plan §3 exactly and are identical across attempts (no boundary shopping). Terminal label matches the preregistered §8 outcome set. (4) Legality: no order paths, no S1 paths, no credential in any committed control file (pattern grep clean), key programmatic from root .env, shadow row untouched, GO unconsumed, registry row correctly still PLANNED_NOT_STARTED pending this audit. (5) Dishonesty hunt: the only soft spots found are evidence-freeze hygiene (T1), wording (T2), an unreachable fail-closed bug (T4), and argv-only command digests (T5) — none flips the conclusion. The BLOCKED close is honest: the kill fired exactly as preregistered, on a token that was authenticated but not entitled, with zero budget consumed and nothing adjusted to rescue the direction.
verdict_rationale: AUTHORIZED with 0 HIGH/CRITICAL. The preregistered E1 kill test fired on measurement (fundamentals 403 on 3/3 living canaries, machine-side frozen), after an honest first attempt on the legacy channel (404x3, archived); the terminal label, budget 0/6 with dead slots, S1 seal, no-orders, credential hygiene, and shadow non-interference all reconcile against frozen artifacts and independent machine-side records; the plan text carrying the kill was frozen before measurement and unchanged after. The MEDIUM finding (unfrozen probe transcript for the eod-200/calendar-403 sub-claims) does not change the conclusion because the kill condition is status!=200-independent and the frozen 403-shape corroborates liveness; it tightens the reopening-condition diagnosis only.
